name: Softball
title: Become a Softball Umpire in Southwest Florida | GNOA
description: Learn positioning, mechanics, rules, and timing to umpire softball in Naples, Collier County, and Southwest Florida.

sections.subhead: Stay in the game. See every play differently.
paragraphs: Softball umpiring puts you close to the action and challenges you to make confident decisions in a game that can change quickly.
You'll learn positioning, mechanics, rules, timing, communication, and how to work with your crew to manage the game.
Greater Naples Officials Association recruits, trains, and develops new and experienced softball umpires throughout Naples, Collier County, and Southwest Florida.

image.alt: Softball plate umpire in a mask set behind the catcher, watching the pitch

sections.heading: Fast Game. Good Position. Strong Judgment.
sections.intro: A pitch can become a bunt, steal, force play, tag play, or play at the plate in seconds. Good umpires learn where to be, what to watch, and when to make the call.

items.title: Stay Close to Softball
items.text: Continue being part of the sport you enjoy.

items.title: Learn the Craft
items.text: Rules, positioning, timing, mechanics, communication, and judgment.

items.title: Work as a Crew
items.text: Plate and base umpires work together to cover the field.

items.title: Challenge Yourself
items.text: Every game brings new situations and opportunities to improve.

sections.heading: Never Umpired Before?
paragraphs: You don't need previous umpiring experience. GNOA helps new softball umpires learn the fundamentals and build confidence before taking on more challenging assignments.
sections.after: You won't learn everything at once. You build it one game at a time.

image.alt: Softball resting on the infield dirt beside the white foul line

sections.heading: How to Get Started
sections.tagline: A clear path from interest to your first games.

items.title: Tell Us You're Interested
items.text: Complete the short form and select Softball.

items.title: Meet the Softball Team
items.text: We'll explain training, registration, equipment, the season, and what to expect.

items.title: Learn the Fundamentals
items.text: Study the rules, practice mechanics and positioning, and learn how a crew works.

items.title: Work Your First Games
items.text: Start with assignments that match your training and experience.

items.title: Keep Getting Better
items.text: Work games, receive feedback, learn from experienced umpires, and continue developing.

items.title: Positioning
items.text: Get the right angle and distance to see the entire play.

items.title: Timing
items.text: See the play finish before making the call.

items.title: Rules Knowledge
items.text: Understand the rules and how to apply them when the unexpected happens.

items.title: Communication
items.text: Work with partners, coaches, players, and game administrators.

items.title: Composure
items.text: Stay calm, communicate professionally, and focus on the next pitch.

sections.text: Stay in the game. See every play differently.
